name: Kopi powder
description: Coffee beans, mostly robusta, roasted dark with sugar and margarine and ground fine. Bold, smoky and slightly caramel.

name: Tea dust
description: Finely broken black tea leaves that brew strong, dark and slightly bitter in minutes.

name: Condensed milk
description: Milk cooked down with sugar until thick and sweet. It sweetens and whitens a drink in one spoonful.

name: Evaporated milk
description: Milk cooked down without sugar. Creamy and a little toasty, it whitens without sweetening.

name: Sugar
description: Plain white sugar. It dissolves fastest in a hot drink.

name: Boiling water
description: Water just off the boil, for brewing.

name: Water
description: Plain water, hot for a hot drink or cold for an iced one, to lengthen it.

name: Milo powder
description: A malted chocolate drink powder made from barley malt, milk and cocoa.

name: Pearl barley
description: Polished barley grains that turn soft and give their water a gentle, nutty flavour.

name: Espresso
description: A small, strong shot of coffee pressed through finely ground beans.

name: Milk
description: Fresh full-cream milk. It steams and froths best cold from the fridge.
